look.speaker: nii
look.text: Is that it? Old Tecno! Chale, give it here — I'll charge it and see if it still turns on.

choices.text: No. It's Kojo's — he should be the first to switch it on.

charged.speaker: nii
charged.text: …It works. Locked with a PIN. I didn't try to get in. …Okay, I tried once. 1234 never works any more.

sealed.speaker: nii
sealed.text: Hmm. Principles. You'll go far — or you'll go broke.
